models.name: Gemma-4-E2B-it
models.description: A variant of Gemma 4 E2B ready for deployment on Android using [LiteRT-LM](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM/blob/main/docs/api/kotlin/getting_started.md). It supports multi-modality input, with up to 32K context length.
models.updateInfo: The updated model leverages Gemma 4's built-in Multi Token Prediction (MTP) for faster decode. Enable or disable MTP using the speculative decoding toggle in inference settings.

models.name: Gemma-4-E4B-it
models.description: A variant of Gemma 4 E4B ready for deployment on Android using [LiteRT-LM](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM/blob/main/docs/api/kotlin/getting_started.md). It supports multi-modality input, with up to 32K context length.
models.updateInfo: The updated model leverages Gemma 4's built-in Multi Token Prediction (MTP) for faster decode. Enable or disable MTP using the speculative decoding toggle in inference settings.

models.name: Gemma-3n-E2B-it
models.description: A variant of [Gemma 3n E2B](https://ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/gemma-3n) ready for deployment on Android using [LiteRT-LM](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM/blob/main/kotlin/README.md). It supports text, vision, and audio input, with 4096 context length.

models.name: Gemma-3n-E4B-it
models.description: A variant of [Gemma 3n E4B](https://ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/gemma-3n) ready for deployment on Android using [LiteRT-LM](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM/blob/main/kotlin/README.md). It supports text, vision, and audio input, with 4096 context length.

models.name: Gemma3-1B-IT
models.description: A variant of [google/Gemma-3-1B-IT](https://huggingface.co/google/Gemma-3-1B-IT) with 4-bit quantization ready for deployment on Android using [LiteRT-LM](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM/blob/main/kotlin/README.md).

models.name: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct
models.description: A variant of [Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct) ready for deployment on Android using [LiteRT-LM](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM/blob/main/kotlin/README.md).

models.name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B
models.description: A variant of [deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B) ready for deployment on Android using [LiteRT-LM](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM/blob/main/kotlin/README.md).

models.name: Gemma-4-E2B-it-sm8750
models.description: Gemma 4 E2B optimised for the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite (SM8750) NPU. **Snapdragon 8 Elite users will see significant performance gains over the standard GPU build.** Supports multi-modality input with up to 32K context length.

models.name: Gemma-4-E2B-it-qcs8275
models.description: Gemma 4 E2B optimised for the Qualcomm QCS8275 NPU. **QCS8275 users will see significant performance gains over the standard GPU build.** Supports multi-modality input with up to 32K context length.

models.name: Gemma-4-E2B-it-Tensor-G5
models.description: Gemma 4 E2B optimised for the Google Tensor G5 (Pixel 10) NPU. **Pixel 10 users will see significant performance gains over the standard GPU build.** Supports multi-modality input with up to 32K context length.

models.name: Gemma-4-12B-it
models.description: Gemma 4 12B — the largest Gemma 4 model, for flagship devices with ample RAM (~6.5 GB download). The current LiteRT-LM build supports text input with up to 32K context length and runs on GPU. Audio and image input are planned in a future model update.

models.name: MobileActions-270M
models.description: Fine-tuned Function Gemma 270M model for Mobile Actions.

models.name: TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat
models.description: TinyLlama 1.1B Chat (int8) — a small, very fast text chat model. ~156 tok/s prefill / ~26 tok/s decode on a Samsung S24 Ultra (CPU/XNNPACK), ~1.1 GB on disk. 1280-token context. Text only.

models.name: Phi-4-mini-instruct
models.description: Microsoft Phi-4-mini-instruct (3.8B, int8) — a capable text-only instruct model. **8 GB+ RAM recommended** — won't load on 6 GB devices (e.g. Pixel 6a). ~314 tok/s prefill / ~10 tok/s decode on GPU (Samsung S24 Ultra), ~3.9 GB on disk, 4096-token context. License: MIT.

models.name: TinySwallow-1.5B-Instruct
models.description: TinySwallow 1.5B Instruct (SakanaAI) — a compact Japanese/English bilingual text model, distilled from Qwen2.5-1.5B. ~1.5 GB on disk. Text only. License: Apache 2.0.

models.name: VibeThinker-1.5B
models.description: VibeThinker 1.5B (WeiboAI) — a compact reasoning model specialised in math and competitive coding (AIME / HMMT / Codeforces), punching well above its size. Not a general-purpose chat model. ~1.5 GB on disk. Text only. License: MIT.

models.name: Qwen3-8B
models.description: Qwen3 8B (channel-wise int8) — a large, highly capable text model. ~8.3 GB download; needs a high-RAM device (12 GB+) for the 8B weights + float32 KV cache. Decode is slow on phones at this size. Text only. License: Apache 2.0.

models.name: Gemma-3-1B-IT-Tensor-G5
models.description: Gemma 3 1B optimised for the Google Tensor G5 (Pixel 10) NPU/TPU. **Pixel 10 users see major speedups over the GPU build.** Text, ~1.25K context. Subject to Google's Gemma Terms of Use and Prohibited Use Policy.

models.name: Gemma-3n-E2B-it-MediaTek
models.description: Gemma 3n E2B optimised for the MediaTek Dimensity 9400 (MT6993) NPU. Multimodal (text, image, audio), up to 32K context. **MediaTek users see major NPU speedups.** Subject to Google's Gemma Terms of Use and Prohibited Use Policy.

models.name: Qwen3-0.6B-MediaTek
models.description: Qwen3 0.6B optimised for the MediaTek Dimensity 9400 (MT6993) NPU (Apache-2.0). a16w8 NPU build, 4K context. **MediaTek users see NPU speedups.**

models.name: Gemma-3-1B-IT-Snapdragon
models.description: Gemma 3 1B optimised for Snapdragon NPUs (Snapdragon 8 Gen 1 through 8 Elite 2). Snapdragon users will see major performance gains over the GPU build. Text only, 1280-token context. Subject to Google's Gemma Terms of Use and Prohibited Use Policy.

models.name: Gemma-3-1B-IT-MediaTek
models.description: Gemma 3 1B optimised for MediaTek Dimensity NPUs (Dimensity 9300+, 9400 Pro, 9400+). MediaTek users will see major performance gains over the GPU build. Text only, 1280-token context. Subject to Google's Gemma Terms of Use and Prohibited Use Policy.

models.name: Gemma-3-270M-Snapdragon
models.description: Gemma 3 270M optimised for Snapdragon NPUs (Snapdragon 8 Gen 1 through 8 Elite 2). Ultra-fast, ~460 MB download. Text only. Subject to Google's Gemma Terms of Use and Prohibited Use Policy.

models.name: Gemma-3-270M-MediaTek
models.description: Gemma 3 270M optimised for MediaTek Dimensity NPUs (Dimensity 9400 Pro, 9400+). Ultra-fast, ~555 MB download. Text only. Subject to Google's Gemma Terms of Use and Prohibited Use Policy.
